name: fuzzy_match_detect_escape_drift
notes: Traced C copy of fuzzy_match_helpers.c::fuzzy_match_detect_escape_drift vs LIVE tools/fuzzy_match.py::_detect_escape_drift (8 inputs: no-suspect early-out, apostrophe/doublequote drift hits, accepted in-file escapes, mixed suspects). Inputs are 'old|new|content' with the matched region = whole content on both sides; error MESSAGE text differs between ports so only the ERR/NONE classification is value-traced. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (avoided here): LIVE's pre-check also falls through to its backslash-doubling stage when old_string contains backslashes without quote suspects, while the C port returns NULL early and lacks the doubling stage entirely — inputs with backslash-runs in old_string are excluded; real port gap worth a follow-up.
